title: geofm-landslide-benchmark: cross-model evaluation protocol and derived datasets for geospatial foundation models in landslide susceptibility
description: Reproducibility package for 'Where do geospatial foundation models help? Cross-model evaluation of TerraMind and Prithvi-EO-2.0 for landslide susceptibility across the Chilean climate gradient' (submitted to Computers & Geosciences). Includes the cross-FM linear-probe benchmark with random-initialization ablation and point-probe controls (context-matched manual baselines, spectral scar probe, constrained-negative sensitivity), the table/figure generators, and the derived datasets: 17-layer geomorphometric feature stacks (npz), Sentinel-2 L2A 2023 composites (GeoTIFF), sampled benchmark points with spatial-block ids (CSV), and per-fold result files (JSON) for three Chilean basins (Huasco, Maipo, Maule).
